findings.passage: Kansas didn’t have the problems that other states had in the November 2020 elections but there is room for improvement. Elections are too important and we need 100% accuracy.
findings.note: From her legislative update posted on Fort Scott Biz (signed by her, dated April 9, 2021), under the heading 'Protecting Elections'. She says Kansas had no major problems in the 2020 elections and still wants improvement.

findings.passage: CCR 2183 will limit ballot harvesting, make it unlawful to alter postmarks on mailed ballots, and require signature verification on mailed ballots.
findings.note: In the same update she describes what the conference committee report on election law (CCR 2183) does, as she sees it, including signature checks on mailed ballots.

findings.passage: Some Senators argued these CCRs and the HCR promote voter suppression and that they are not needed.  That is not even true.  They help protect the integrity of our elections.
findings.note: She answers critics of CCR 2183, CCR 2332 and HCR 5015 and says the measures protect election integrity.

findings.passage: “Who is discriminating?” Tyson said. “I know my county clerks would be completely offended by your comments. They are not discriminating against anyone. So who are you insinuating is discriminating?”
findings.note: Kansas Reflector story (republished by the Lawrence Times) quoting her at the Feb. 2, 2026 Senate committee hearing on a bill to end mail-in ballots if the signature verification law cannot be enforced; she answers a witness who said signature checks discriminate.
Same story: the reporter's caption quotes her calling the signature-verification / mail-ballot bill common sense legislation.

findings.passage: “These remote boxes that are not monitored can be tampered with,” Tyson said.
